notes.title: Cellbit Awards 2023!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We had a brand new trailer for The Tale of LUMI that was showcased at the Cellbit Awards 2023!

We also have a Discord Server for everyone to join! 
We are organizing playtesting, sneak peaks, polls to decide certain parts of the game and also some rewards and freebies in there, so if you are interested make sure to join us!

[url=https://discord.gg/GFNhTxNRb7][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2334400/extras/lumi_discord_invitation_1.png[/img][/url]

Oh and yes here's the new trailer:
[previewyoutube=xp0uUwzXVXw;full][/previewyoutube]

More updates coming soon!

Very best, 
Vitor

notes.title: The Tale of LUMI Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we released our first Teaser Trailer for The Tale of LUMI!
In this trailer we share more about gameplay and some cool environments that we are working on!

Here's the Teaser Trailer for The Tale of LUMI:

[previewyoutube=Q5s7929hBUM;full][/previewyoutube]

We will be sharing more about the game's development as we are preparing a demo for everyone to try! 
Thanks for reading and for the support

Wish you the very best,
Vitor
